notes: DEVIATION JUDGMENT (no-op-on-undefined increment/reset): SOUND, not a masked bug. Plan specified `(ctx[counter] ?? 0) + 1`; executor changed incFixLoopPatch/resetFixLoopPatch (actions.ts:76-101) to no-op when the counter field is undefined, mutating only when it is already a number. (1) Structural: getAdjacencyMap (graph.test.ts:38-52) explores from the machine's `{}` default context and JSON-serializes context; a nullish-base increment would mint an ever-growing checksFixIteration across the checks<->execute loop → infinite distinct serialized states → hang. no-op-on-undefined keeps the `{}` context invariant during exploration → finite 21-edge graph, and keeps parityContext() (no counters) parity-green. (2) Production correctness: the live write path is mutateState → lucaStateSchemaTolerant.parse (schemas.ts:146 = lucaStateSchema.passthrough()), which inherits checksFixIteration/verifyIteration/reviewIteration .default(0) (schemas.ts:116-120); the bootstrap path uses lucaStateSchema.parse({}) (advance handler:229) which also defaults them. Therefore decideAdvance ALWAYS threads defined numbers → increments/resets ALWAYS fire in production (verified no live path reads counters without the schema default). The no-op branch is UNREACHABLE in production. (3) Deviation does not weaken any ac: ac-07 tested with seeded checksFixIteration (1→2), ac-08 reset→0, ac-06 advisory over-budget still allowed. VERDICT: the deviation reinforces the advisory/parity invariant rather than hiding a real increment bug. VERIFY-STAGE SUBSTITUTION: independent tsc and bun-test re-runs were stage-gate-blocked (bash-mutate BLOCK in pipelineStep=verify); ac-13/14/15/16 rely on DUAL evidence — structural probes (git diff --stat proving parity/guard/transitions/relaxation/graph files byte-unchanged; Read of test bodies) PLUS the checks-step attestation (tsc 0, luca-core 995/0, parity 516/0 incl graph, handler green). git diff and Read probes ran successfully in-stage.
